items.title: How North Carolina Escaped Nuclear Disaster… Twice
items.author: ColdFusion
items.content:
<article>Try Wispr Flow for free  https://ref.wisprflow.ai/coldfusion-yt and use code COLDFUSION to get 1 month of Wispr Flow Pro with unlimited words! 

The world came frighteningly close to the greatest nuclear disaster in history, but the story of the event isn't that well known. Two hydrogen bombs ~250 times more powerful than the ones dropped on Hiroshima accidently fell on North Carolina. Both weapons hit the ground one of them very well should have gone off but didn't. Why? In this episode we explore the 1961 goldsboro b-52 incident.

items.title: We’ve Seen the Sun’s Inner Corona For the First Time... and It's Not What We Expected
items.author: Astrum
items.content:
<article>Proba-3 revealed the Sun’s inner corona for the first time. 
Get the DWARF mini Solar Eclipse Travel Kit at 10% off through July 31: https://bit.ly/astrum-eclipse26. After July 31, use code ASTRUM5 at checkout on dwarflab.com. Eclipse preparation guide: https://help.dwarflab.com/en/docs/2026-solar-eclipse?product=dwarf-mini

▀▀▀▀▀▀

ESA’s Proba-3 mission has achieved a world first. It created an artificial eclipse in space. Not just once, but over 50 times. In this video, we’ll discover how these two tiny probes are revolutionising our ability to study the Sun’s inner corona, and what they found on its surface.
